intro: Things made right here in Kannapolis. First up: a veteran-owned brewery on West Avenue.

makers.name: Old Armor Beer Company
makers.about: Old Armor Beer is owned and operated by combat veterans who served overseas. Every year they dedicate 12 unique brews to charitable foundations.
makers.image_alt: Earnhardt Outdoors Ale can: black-and-gold checkered flag, 'Kannapolis, NC, Home of the Earnhardts'

beers.name: Earnhardt Outdoors Ale
beers.about: Brewed to celebrate the Earnhardt heritage, for fans of racing and the outdoors. The can reads "Kannapolis, NC: Home of the Earnhardts."

beers.name: Stinger Ale
beers.about: A tribute to the Charlotte Hornets, made for game nights.

makers.beers_note: Plus year-round, rotating and seasonal taps at the taproom.

pay_it_forward.title: Pay It Forward Board
pay_it_forward.text: Buy a "Pint of Freedom" for a veteran or first responder and pick a military branch or department ($6.50), or run the whole board ($52). They claim it by showing proof of service to the brewtender.

good_to_know: Bands: apply with the artist button at the bottom of the weekly events calendar, not by email.
Private events in the Brew Space: email pr@oldarmorbeer.net.
Hiring? Stop by Monday–Thursday during business hours.
